tool_args.rationale: Acquire the specified wide-gradient probe to distinguish the open branch and identify vmax and rho before fitting over the full fallback parameter ranges.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model using the pilot rows alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad span makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, leaving their effects unidentifiable for wider gradients.
The ambiguity concerns gradient dependence and branch form, not temporal resolution; this probe also costs more.
The pilot is monotone concave rather than decreasing at high input; the discriminating probe can resolve the competing branch behavior.
